For n≥3, 1≤t≤3 q=t², symmetrizing an arbitrary noncontracting Euclidean embedding by simultaneous permutations and side swap preserves distortion and gives squared-distance variables (a,b,c) with 4≤a≤4T,1≤b≤T,q≤c≤qT. Centered Gram constraints imply |b−c|≤a and (n−1)a≤(n−1)b+c. Combining constraints gives T≥4(n−1)/(n−1+q), T≥4(n−2)/n, T≥q(n−2)/(2(n−1)). Explicit correlated regular simplex copies parameterized by ρ=(b−c)/a attain each branch, with ρ=−1 for plateau and large-q, and meet all lower/upper constraints at q_−=2(n−1)/(n−2),q_+=8(n−1)/n. Independently optimized the 4-variable orbit LP (a,b,c,T) at 24 points and checked attained Gram constraints. All q real in [1,9] follow analytically; boundary cases n=3 and q=1,9 included.
